date_basis: source trading date, previous completed ISO week only
missing_policy: missing return invalidates whole ISO week and restarts index/EMA segment
unknown_policy: fall back to A0; weekly_direction=0 has no meaning unless weekly_ready=true
coverage_denominator: all source days x fixed formal19, includes prelisting days; diagnostic only, not candidate-signal coverage
artifact_filename_change: Renamed existing cache weekly_features.csv to weekly_daily.csv; no feature recomputation
diagnostic_reason_label_limitation: P2: missing_product_returns vs missing_previous_week_returns can change when a future finite product observation is appended because the former diagnosis checks whole-source presence. reason is a diagnostic label only, prohibited for trading/qualification. Decision fields weekly_ready/weekly_direction/weekly_hist/weekly_hist_prev/weekly_asof remain causal and unchanged.
forward_invariance_scope: Actual decision fields only; diagnostic reason is not fully invariant for a wholly missing product before first future finite observation.
